prompt: Finish the SQL preflight cache for safe reuse of successful validation. Inspect the code, preserve the public exports and valid cache reuse, add appropriate regression coverage and run the relevant checks. Do not commit.

files.README.md:
# SQL preflight

The preflight validates SELECT access to protected_probe under the current effective role.
It caches a successful validation using an observed schema digest and server version.
Public exports are observeEnvironment, fingerprint and validateSql. validateSql reports
source=executed or source=reused and propagates SQL errors. Its optional observation argument
lets callers supply an environment observation. Keep successful reuse for unchanged, completely
described environments. The cache stores only completed successes.

Run bun test and bun run typecheck. The SQL engine is PostgreSQL 18.6 through PGlite 0.5.16,
running entirely in memory; no server or external data is needed.

setup:
exec 2>&1
set -eu
bun --config=/dev/null --no-env-file install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
bun test
bun run typecheck
